newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's TBC seen cut to 1.74 pct in Dec - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's TBC seen cut to 1.74 pct in Dec - paper.

text.p: The Central Bank's Monetary Policy Committee (Copom) is likely to cut to 1.74 percent Brazil's Basic Interest Rate of the Central Bank (TBC) for December, O Globo newspaper said.
November's TBC rate was set at 1.78 percent, it added.
The newspaper said the commitee, which meets today, will consider inflation and the public deficit to set the new TBC rate.
The TBC, which is set on a monthly basis and was first introduced in July, is used as a reference rate for Central Bank rediscount loans and PROER credit lines.
